items.title: Texas Is Racing to Approve SpaceX’s $24 Billion Starbase Data Center Before Its New Governor Can Halt It
items.summary: Key TakeawaysOne of Texas’s first data-center permits since its freeze went to the gas plant powering SpaceX’s $24 billion Starbase campus, ahead of Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa, who plans to halt approvals when she takes office in January. Starbase’s own gas plant keeps it off the public grid.
